Apple continues to expand its car key feature support across the automotive industry, and the function now appears to be set to arrive on certain models from a major Chinese car manufacturer. Details are as follows.

Apple Wallet car key feature reportedly coming to GWM Tank

According to MacRumors, new backend code suggests Apple may soon extend the Apple Wallet car key feature to the Tank lineup under Great Wall Motors (GWM).

Several GWM models already support Apple CarPlay, including the Tank 300, Tank 400, Tank 500 and Tank 700, as well as models from the Haval, Ora, Wey and Poer brands.

However, no models currently support the car key feature, which allows drivers to use an iPhone or Apple Watch to lock, unlock and start compatible vehicles.

Just days before this news, other backend code indicated the car key feature would be coming to Volkswagen vehicles. Apple continues to expand car key support following recent rollouts for Toyota and Rivian.

In 2025, Apple announced that 13 additional car brands would add support for the car key feature, including GWM's Wey brand, as well as Acura, Cadillac, Chery, Chevrolet, GMC, Hongqi, Lucid, Porsche, Rivian, Smart, Tata Motors and Voyah.

According to Apple's website, more than 800 car models currently support CarPlay, of which 52 also support the car key feature. The full compatibility list is available via this link.
